mapper.sql: select shipment_detail_id, shipment_id, transfer_id, transfer_detail_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, product_id, product_name, planned_quantity, shipped_quantity, received_quantity, cost_price from inv_transfer_shipment_detail
mapper.select: where shipment_id = #{shipmentId} order by shipment_detail_id asc
where transfer_id = #{transferId} order by shipment_id asc, shipment_detail_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_shipment_detail ( shipment_id, transfer_id, transfer_detail_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, product_id, product_name, planned_quantity, shipped_quantity, received_quantity, cost_price ) values ( #{shipmentId}, #{transferId}, #{transferDetailId}, coalesce(#{itemType}, 'product'), coalesce(#{itemId}, #{productId}), #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{plannedQuantity}, #{shippedQuantity}, #{receivedQuantity}, #{costPrice} )

insert into inv_transfer_shipment_detail ( shipment_id, transfer_id, transfer_detail_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, product_id, product_name, planned_quantity, shipped_quantity, received_quantity, cost_price ) values
